definitions.invalid: Exact narrow implemented contracts only: eligible marker existence in pure man, eligible target, zone destination within end line, called spill with same-side outside force partner at snap.
definitions.inspectionPoint: Descriptive direct relationship/overlap/support transitions. Zone, help, bracket and intended release can explain them; no bust classification.
definitions.readTick: Controller boundary at 20 Hz, before PlaySim increments time. Declared receiver keys are copied only from that tick's actual ReleaseReader cache; no new observations.
definitions.directOwnership: Recorded man/wall/trap/rob target relationships, not complete coverage influence. Selected zone targets are separate. No communication/acknowledgment model exists here.
definitions.interpretation: Rule state and consumed keys are witnesses, not a claim about an unexposed causal trigger. Behavior labels can persist during run pursuit.
definitions.cap: First 100 state/key transitions per fixture retained; total and omitted counts are explicit.
limitations: No NFL tracking or authentic call-sheet verification in this fixture panel.
No communication event or independent gaze/hip measurements; body facing does not establish eye target.
No threshold fitting or coverage behavior changes; spacing alone is never called a bust.
The standard replay does not yet retain this new getter's structured branch/read fields. This lab reads them live.

units.facing: radians; body orientation, not eye tracking

retention: Initial inventory/state and all seven inspection points are retained with exact-controller-boundary witnesses. Full transition history stays in ignored out/literature/coverage-contracts-final.json.
witnessProvenance: Six inspection points use same-boundary retained transitions. LB_W at 1.05 s was copied by an ignored observational prototype wrapper because that tick did not change a recorded branch/declaration. The recaptured fixture result, events and all retained transitions exactly match the ordinary diagnostic run. No new perception calls, interpretation or RNG were added.
